name: Repository
description: Several agent runs on one small library, read as a code forge shows them: any runs picked or compared issue by issue, pull requests, issues, discussions and agents in tabs filtered on every field, and a pull request's whole story with its commits, diffs, reviews and the file of each entry.

accepts.means: the record on line <n> of a run's file, shown in its pull request, issue, discussion or agent; a manifest's line opens its run

units.means: one run: its measures, with the view narrowed to it
one pull request with its commits, reviews, comments and merge or close
one issue with its comments and the pull requests that close it
one discussion, every post in time order
one agent: its note, its activity and its review partners

derived.from: the folder a file is in, and the manifest's run or id
number, a commit's or review's pull

derived.how: ISO 8601, epoch milliseconds or local time read as hours since the run started; a time without an offset is in the manifest's timezone, else UTC

derived.from: the merge's actor or user, or merged_by in pulls.csv

derived.how: the first number, where it is free text

derived.from: a push's diff or a commit's patch
derived.how: the lines it adds and removes

derived.from: labels or area, else the issue it fixes
its merge, close and reopen records
each reviewer's last verdict that is not a comment
derived.how: how many approved and how many asked for changes
merged by its author, merged over a change request, pushed after its last approval, or waiting for approvals

derived.from: its close records and the pull requests that fix it
derived.how: fixed when a pull request that fixes it is merged

derived.from: its opening time and the run's start
derived.how: backlog when it was opened before the run started, else found during the run
the merged pull request that fixes it
the issue in each other run, with its state and pull requests

derived.from: type or event, else the export table a row is in
derived.how: commit, review, comment, merge, close or reopen

derived.from: actor, user, author, user.login in reviews.json
derived.how: user read as actor; a review from a gone account is unknown
as for opened; a post with no time takes the time of the line before it
approved, changes requested or commented, in lower case

derived.from: the manifest's agents or team, and the agents/ transcripts

derived.how: per author it reviewed, its approvals and change requests

derived.from: the manifest's started, else the first record

derived.how: the first number, where it is written as free text
